mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.course_id, e.semester_id, e.exam_date, e.start_section, e.end_section, e.room, e.invigilator_uid, e.type, c.name AS course_name, sem.name AS semester_name, t.name AS invigilator_name FROM exam_arrange e LEFT JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN semester sem ON sem.id = e.semester_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.tid = e.invigilator_uid ORDER BY e.exam_date, e.start_section, e.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_arrange (course_id, semester_id, exam_date, start_section, end_section, room, invigilator_uid, type) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{semesterId}, #{examDate}, #{startSection}, #{endSection}, #{room}, #{invigilatorUid}, #{type})
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_arrange SET course_id = #{courseId}, semester_id = #{semesterId}, exam_date = #{examDate}, start_section = #{startSection}, end_section = #{endSection}, room = #{room}, invigilator_uid = #{invigilatorUid}, type = #{type} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, e.semester_id AS semesterId, sem.name AS semesterName, e.exam_date AS examDate, e.start_section AS startSection, e.end_section AS endSection, e.room, e.type, e.invigilator_uid AS invigilatorUid, t.name AS invigilatorName FROM exam_arrange e JOIN course_selection cs ON cs.course_id = e.course_id AND (cs.semester_id <=> e.semester_id) LEFT JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN semester sem ON sem.id = e.semester_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.tid = e.invigilator_uid WHERE cs.sid = #{sid} ORDER BY e.exam_date, e.start_section, e.id
